name: Phase 7 Provisional Pre-Summary Field Set
description: Provisional structured pre-summary schema seeded from the Phase 0 Daltonganj Hindi corpus. This version is the reference ground-truth schema for corpus pre-summaries; it seeds the Phase 7 pre-summary schema (FEAT-007). Provisional and versioned; a stable schema is defined at PHASE-7.

fields.name: clip_id
fields.description: Corpus clip identifier, e.g. sample_0002. Matches manifest clip_id.

fields.name: cohort
fields.description: Dialect cohort assigned to the clip.

fields.name: field_set_version
fields.description: Version of this field set used to author the pre-summary.

fields.name: chief_complaint
fields.description: Primary presenting complaint stated in the recording. null when not stated in the clip.

fields.name: onset
fields.description: When the complaint started, verbatim where possible (e.g. '4 days ago', 'this morning').

fields.name: duration
fields.description: How long the complaint has persisted.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Body part/region involved.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Patient-stated or inferred intensity.

fields.name: nature
fields.description: Character/quality of the complaint (burning, dull, intermittent, etc.).

fields.name: associated_symptoms
fields.description: Other symptoms reported alongside the chief complaint.

fields.name: aggravating_factors
fields.description: Factors that worsen the complaint.

fields.name: relieving_factors
fields.description: Factors that relieve the complaint.

fields.name: known_medications
fields.description: Medications mentioned (current or prescribed). Each item: {name, strength, frequency, route, duration, note}.

fields.name: allergies
fields.description: Known allergies reported in the clip.

fields.name: past_history
fields.description: Patient's own past/chronic conditions and ongoing treatments.

fields.name: family_history
fields.description: Family medical history mentioned in the clip.

fields.name: vitals
fields.description: Vitals/measurements read out in the clip. Unmeasured keys are null.

fields.name: labs_ordered
fields.description: Investigations/tests ordered in the clip.

fields.name: diagnosis_impression
fields.description: Doctor's stated diagnosis or clinical impression.

fields.name: advice
fields.description: Doctor's advice/instructions given in the clip.

fields.name: follow_up
fields.description: Follow-up instructions, if any.

fields.name: clinical_notes
fields.description: Free-text clinical context: consultation stage, who is speaking, non-clinical observations relevant to structuring.

fields.name: extraction_notes
fields.description: Structuring confidence notes: which fields are unambiguous, which are partial, and known gaps.
